content.thinking: The user wants me to SSH to westd-29999 and check the status of Phase 2 evaluations. Let me use the ssh_execute tool to run the commands.

input.command:
echo "=== nvidia-smi ==="
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,utilization.gpu,memory.used,memory.total --format=csv,noheader

echo "=== tmux sessions ==="
tmux ls 2>/dev/null

echo "=== OLMo monitor log ==="
cat /root/autodl-tmp/exp001/phase2_logs/olmo2_monitor.log 2>/dev/null

echo "=== eval processes ==="
ps aux | grep evaluate.py | grep -v grep

echo "=== eval_results_v2 scan ==="
cd /root/autodl-tmp/exp001/eval_results_v2
for dir in phi4_d100 qwen14b_d100 olmo2_d000 olmo2_d005 olmo2_d025 olmo2_d050 olmo2_d100; do
    if [ -f "${dir}/eval_results.json" ]; then
        echo -n "${dir}: DONE — "
        python3 -c "
import json
with open('${dir}/eval_results.json') as f:
    d = json.load(f)
mmlu = d.get('mmlu_accuracy', d.get('mmlu', {}).get('accuracy', 'N/A'))
arc = d.get('arc_challenge_accuracy', d.get('arc_challenge', {}).get('accuracy', 'N/A'))
print(f'MMLU={mmlu}, ARC={arc}')
"
    elif [ -d "${dir}" ]; then
        echo "${dir}: INCOMPLETE (dir exists, no results yet)"
    else
        echo "${dir}: MISSING"
    fi
done
